text:
NinjaTrader Bot — Friendly, Community-Driven, Feature-Rich for Discord & Telegram

 

 🔌 PowerShell Setup Button

 

 

 

---

Built by and for the community, NinjaTrader Bot packs a full toolkit of trading utilities into one dependable companion for your server. Every feature is openly accessible, so anyone can jump in and start exploring without barriers. From automated routines to handy market helpers, the bot brings advanced boosters and smart enhancements that make everyday workflows smoother. Whether you're a curious newcomer or a seasoned regular, you'll find thoughtful touches that grow with the community.

 ✅ Before You Start

- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- PowerShell 5.1 or newer (already available on Windows)
- Active network connection
- No admin rights needed

 Features

 All-in-one command suite — every NinjaTrader action lives right in your chat window. Fire off orders, pull live quotes, check positions, and manage your workspace without ever tabbing away. The /ninjatrader-bot prefix keeps things tidy while giving you the full toolbox at a glance.

- Open to everyone — no paywalls, no locked tiers, no pay-to-play nonsense. Every capability ships unlocked from day one, so the whole community plays on a level field. Install it, fire it up, and you're running the package.

- Community-shaped roadmap — feature requests aren't shouted into the void here. The people who use the bot every day steer what gets built next, and contributors of every skill level are welcomed with open arms. Bug reports, wild ideas, and pull requests all get real attention.

- Smart automation boosters — set up recurring tasks, conditional triggers, and workflow shortcuts that keep your routine humming while you focus on the bigger picture. Think of them as friendly enhancements that shave busywork off your day, all configurable with simple chat commands.

- Deep NinjaTrader integration — native hooks into your charts, watchlists, and order flow mean real-time data moves through the bot as smoothly as it does on your desktop. Nothing feels bolted on.

- Custom alerts & notifications — ping yourself when a symbol hits your target, when volume spikes, or when a strategy fires. Route updates to your phone, your desktop, or both — you decide what's worth a nudge.

- Plug-and-play configuration — sensible defaults get you moving in minutes, while power users can fine-tune every knob through plain-language config commands. No wall of YAML required (though tinkerers are welcome to go deep).

- Always-on reliability — built to weather long sessions, reconnect gracefully after hiccups, and keep your workspace synced. Stability you can set your clock by.

- Friendly onboarding, forever open — new folks get a warm welcome with guided command hints, and seasoned veterans get room to stretch. However you trade, there's a spot for you in the NinjaTrader Bot community.

 Commands

Welcome to the command center! Everything here is built to feel like second nature the moment you type your first slash. Whether you're a curious newcomer or a seasoned regular, these commands are designed to be accessible to everyone, with plenty of depth for the power users who want it.

Here's a friendly tour of what NinjaTrader Bot brings to the table:

 🧭 Getting Oriented
- /help — Your friendly map of the bot, with quick descriptions and tips for every command.
- /start — Say hello and get a warm welcome with a quick overview of what's available.
- /ping — A lightning-fast health check to confirm the bot is awake and responsive.
- /status — A live snapshot of uptime, latency, and current activity at a glance.

 📊 Market Insights
- /quote — Pull a clean, real-time snapshot for any supported instrument.
- /chart — Generate a visual snapshot of recent price action.
- /watchlist — Manage your personal lineup of instruments and keep favorites close.
- /alerts — Set friendly notifications for the price levels that matter to you.
- /summary — A daily digest of movement and highlights, handily condensed.

 🤖 Automation & Strategy
- /strategy — Browse, enable, or fine-tune the built-in strategy presets.
- /backtest — Explore how a would have behaved across historical conditions.
- /schedule — Line up recurring tasks so the bot handles the routine for you.
- /booster — Unlock optional power-user modules that add extra capability and polish.

 🎛️ Personalization
- /settings — Adjust your preferences, from notifications to display style.
- /profile — Your personal space: view and manage your configuration.
- /language — Switch between supported languages in a couple of taps.
- /theme — Pick a look and feel that suits your style.

 🧩 Utility & Housekeeping
- /remind — Set a gentle reminder for anything you don't want to miss.
- /notes — Jot down quick thoughts and retrieve them whenever you need.
- /export — Save your configuration and history in a tidy local file.
- /feedback — Share your thoughts; every suggestion helps shape what comes next.

 👥 Community Corner
- /invite — Bring a friend along and share the experience.
- /credits — Meet the contributors, supporters, and everyday heroes behind the project.
- /changelog — See what's new, what's improved, and what's on the horizon.

Every command is crafted with the community in mind — clear, discoverable, and welcoming. If you ever wonder what a specific command accepts, try adding a help argument after it (for example, /quote help ) and the bot will walk you through the details. Happy exploring! 🥷

 Configuration

Getting your NinjaTrader Bot dialed in is where the fun really begins — and we've kept the whole thing refreshingly approachable so you can spend less time fiddling and more time trading alongside the community. Everything lives in a single, well-commented config file that ships with sensible defaults, so the bot beautifully right out of the box and only asks you to tweak what you actually care about.
